answers.answer: You can choose store credit instead of a refund on any return:
answers.question: Can I get store credit instead of a refund?

answers.answer: If the card you paid with has expired or been cancelled, your bank normally passes the refund to your new card;
answers.question: What happens to my refund if my card has expired?

answers.answer: Digital items, such as gift cards and downloadable patterns, are not refundable once the code has been sent.
answers.question: Are digital items refundable?
